finding: 25 of 128 bus routes carry half of Chicago’s weekday bus riders. 27 routes come every 10 minutes or better at midday, and they carry 48% of riders.

ledger.source: CTA - Ridership - Bus Routes - Daily Totals by Route

method: Weekday rides in the window / weekdays in the window; routes running part of the year are averaged over the whole year
Service from CTA GTFS (feed of 2026-09-14) on Wednesday 2026-10-14: trips, vehicle-hours, midday interval 10:00-15:00
One shape per route, one direction; routes on a shared street drawn as offset parallels

caveats: Riders are boardings on the whole route, not the load on any one street
Ridership runs to 2026-08-31; service is the schedule of 2026-10-14
